summary: Rebuilt and clean-import validated as a 0.427 m practical full-tang utility/fighting knife. The actual-GLB renders were opened: the 125 mm by 36 mm matte grip, 44 mm-wide drop/clip-point blade, compact guard, and integrated tang eye correct the rejected swollen silhouette, while blackened fittings, satin steel, and the brighter ground bevel remain visibly distinct. Technical validation reports 584 triangles, 10 mesh objects, 4 materials, zero degenerate polygons, zero source non-manifold edges, and all required attachment nodes; supervisor independent visual approval remains pending.
